title: Native modal
text: Built on the native dialog element, with an inert page and contained focus.

title: Cancelable close
text: Escape and backdrop clicks follow a set policy and raise a cancel event you can veto.

title: Focus restored
text: Focus returns to where it was before the dialog opened.

title: Footer actions
text: Action buttons close the dialog and report which one was pressed.

title: Alert dialogs
text: An alert dialog role for confirmations of destructive actions.
